privacy.sectionDesc: All loan records stay on your device. Optionally share anonymous aggregate counts so we know which features to improve.
privacy.toggleLabel: Help improve KamChi by sharing anonymous usage statistics
privacy.toggleSubLabel: Counts and bucketed ranges only. No borrower or loan details are ever shared.
privacy.statusOff: Off — nothing is sent to Google Analytics
privacy.buildDisabledHint: Analytics are inactive in development/test builds unless enabled with a Measurement ID.

sharedModal.title: What would be shared
sharedModal.subtitle: Live preview of the exact anonymous daily summary computed from your local ledger.
neverSentItems: Borrower names, phone numbers, addresses, national ID info, or photos
Notes, contracts, collateral descriptions, or any free text
License keys or your device code
Exact loan amounts, balances, interest rates, or individual loan/payment dates
Any custom user ID or ad tracking identifier
sharedModal.perInstallBody: "Per lender" means per install. GA4 gives this browser or phone a random anonymous ID (so we can see e.g. "this install has 12 loans") without knowing who you are. Clearing site data or reinstalling resets it.

feedback.cardDesc: Share suggestions or report what would make KamChi more useful for your lending workflow.
feedback.promptTitle: How is KamChi working for you?
feedback.promptBody: Tap a rating below. Your rating stays on this device only and helps us ask if you'd like to share feedback.
